<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-chrome="dark">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>UI & UX Design Styles — 80 Live Examples</title>
<meta name="description" content="A live, interactive gallery of 80 UI/UX design styles: Glassmorphism, Neumorphism, Claymorphism, Neo-Brutalism, Material, Cyberpunk, Bauhaus, Risograph, Windows 95 and many more — searchable and self-contained.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Archivo+Black&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Press+Start+2P&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=VT323&family=Pacifico&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* =========================================================
   BASE / RESET
   ========================================================= */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
button,input{font-family:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #7c9cff;outline-offset:2px}

/* =========================================================
   PAGE CHROME (neutral shell so each demo pops)
   ========================================================= */
:root{
  --font-ui:'Inter','Space Grotesk',system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  --font-display:'Space Grotesk','Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --maxw:1120px;
}
html[data-chrome="dark"]{
  --page:#0b0c10; --page2:#111319; --ink:#eef1f7; --muted:#98a0b3;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.08); --card:#14161d; --accent:#7c9cff;
  --nav-bg:rgba(11,12,16,.72);
}
html[data-chrome="light"]{
  --page:#eef0f5; --page2:#f6f7fb; --ink:#141720; --muted:#5b6274;
  --line:rgba(0,0,0,.10); --card:#ffffff; --accent:#4260ff;
  --nav-bg:rgba(246,247,251,.78);
}
body{
  font-family:var(--font-ui);
  color:var(--ink);
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 15% -5%, color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 16%, transparent), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 500px at 100% 0%, color-mix(in srgb,#ff6ec7 12%, transparent), transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(var(--page),var(--page2));
  background-attachment:fixed;
  line-height:1.55;
}

/* ---- Hero ---- */
.hero{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(48px,8vw,110px) 22px 34px}
.hero .eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:100px;
  padding:7px 14px;margin-bottom:22px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)
}
.hero .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--accent)}
.hero h1{
  font-family:var(--font-display);
  font-weight:700;line-height:1.02;margin:0 0 16px;
  font-size:clamp(38px,7vw,74px);letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.hero h1 span{
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#7c9cff,#c98bff 40%,#ff6ec7 70%,#ffb86b);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.hero p.lead{max-width:60ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,19px);margin:0 0 8px}
.hero .meta{margin-top:20px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.hero .meta b{color:var(--ink)}

/* ---- Sticky quick-nav ---- */
.nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
  background:var(--nav-bg);backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(140%);
  border-block:1px solid var(--line);
}
.nav-inner{
  max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:11px 16px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
}
.nav-brand{font-weight:700;font-family:var(--font-display);white-space:nowrap;font-size:15px}
.nav-brand small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;font-size:12px}
.nav-scroll{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;padding:2px;flex:1;
  scroll-snap-type:x proximity;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.nav-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{height:6px}
.nav-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line);border-radius:20px}
.nav-scroll a{
  scroll-snap-align:start;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:100px;
  border:1px solid transparent;transition:.18s
}
.nav-scroll a:hover{color:var(--ink);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 8%,transparent)}
.nav-scroll a.active{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 22%,transparent)}
.chrome-toggle{
  flex:none;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);
  width:38px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px;line-height:1;transition:.18s
}
.chrome-toggle:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 8%,transparent)}

/* ---- Search field ---- */
.nav-row{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:9px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.nav-row + .nav-row{padding-top:0;padding-bottom:10px}
.search{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center}
.search svg{position:absolute;left:12px;width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--muted);fill:none;stroke-width:2;pointer-events:none}
.search input{
  width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 5%,transparent);
  color:var(--ink);border-radius:100px;padding:9px 84px 9px 34px;font-size:13.5px;transition:.18s;
}
.search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
.search input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 10%,transparent);outline:none}
.search .kbd{
  position:absolute;right:11px;display:flex;gap:4px;pointer-events:none;transition:.18s;
}
.search .kbd kbd{
  font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-ui);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:5px;padding:4px 6px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 6%,transparent)
}
.search input:focus ~ .kbd{opacity:0}
.search .clear{
  position:absolute;right:9px;border:none;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 12%,transparent);
  color:var(--ink);width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;line-height:1;
  display:none;place-items:center;padding:0
}
.search.has-query .kbd{display:none}
.search.has-query .clear{display:grid}
.result-count{flex:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ---- Category chips ---- */
.cat-scroll{display:flex;gap:6px;flex:none;padding:2px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);margin-right:6px;padding-right:12px}
.cat-scroll button{
  cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:100px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);transition:.18s
}
.cat-scroll button:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.cat-scroll button.on{color:var(--ink);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 26%,transparent);border-color:transparent}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .nav-row.rows{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .cat-scroll{overflow-x:auto;flex:1 0 100%;border-right:none;margin:0 0 8px;padding-right:2px;scrollbar-width:none}
  .cat-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
}

/* ---- Filter state ---- */
.is-hidden{display:none !important}
#noResults{
  max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:90px 22px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)
}
#noResults b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;margin-bottom:6px}

/* ---- Section shell ---- */
.style{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(40px,6vw,76px) 22px;scroll-margin-top:132px}
@media (max-width:820px){.style{scroll-margin-top:168px}}
.style > header{margin-bottom:26px}
.style .index{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.2em}
.style h2{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  font-size:clamp(26px,4.4vw,44px);margin:4px 0 8px;
}
.style .desc{color:var(--muted);max-width:70ch;margin:0;font-size:clamp(14px,1.7vw,16px)}
.style .tags{margin-top:12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.style .tags span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:4px 9px;border-radius:100px;letter-spacing:.04em}

/* Generic demo stage */
.demo{border-radius:22px;padding:clamp(22px,4vw,40px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.demo .row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;align-items:center}
.demo h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:19px}
.demo p{margin:0}

/* Footer */
footer.foot{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:50px 22px 80px;color:var(--muted);
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;text-align:center}
footer.foot b{color:var(--ink)}

/* ============================================================
   1. GLASSMORPHISM
   ============================================================ */
.demo--glass{
  background:
    radial-gradient(700px 340px at 12% 15%,#ff8ec7,transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(600px 360px at 85% 10%,#7a5cff,transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(700px 500px at 60% 100%,#22d3ee,transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#5b3cff,#c026d3);
  color:#fff;
}
.glass-card{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);
  border-radius:20px;padding:26px;max-width:340px;
  box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(20,0,60,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.glass-card h3{font-weight:700}
.glass-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:14px}
.glass-btn{
  margin-top:18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding:11px 20px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);transition:.25s;
}
.glass-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.34);box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,255,255,.55);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.glass-pill{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:16px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}

/* reusable "glass" toggle */
.tgl{position:relative;display:inline-flex;width:52px;height:30px;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.tgl input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;cursor:pointer}
.tgl .track{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:100px;transition:.28s}
.tgl .knob{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:.28s;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.tgl input:checked ~ .knob{left:25px}
.glass-tgl .track{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.glass-tgl input:checked ~ .track{background:rgba(88,255,190,.55)}

/* ============================================================
   2. NEUMORPHISM
   ============================================================ */
.demo--neu{background:#e0e5ec;color:#43506b}
.neu-card{
  background:#e0e5ec;border-radius:26px;padding:28px;max-width:360px;
  box-shadow:12px 12px 26px #b9bfca,-12px -12px 26px #ffffff;
}
.neu-card h3{color:#3a4665}
.neu-card p{color:#6b7590;font-size:14px}
.neu-btn{
  margin-top:8px;border:none;cursor:pointer;background:#e0e5ec;color:#4a5878;font-weight:700;
  padding:14px 22px;border-radius:16px;transition:.15s;
  box-shadow:7px 7px 16px #b9bfca,-7px -7px 16px #ffffff;
}
.neu-btn:hover{color:#2f3d5e}
.neu-btn:active{box-shadow:inset 6px 6px 12px #b9bfca,inset -6px -6px 12px #ffffff}
.neu-tgl{width:60px;height:32px;border-radius:100px;background:#e0e5ec;position:relative;cursor:pointer;flex:none;
  box-shadow:inset 5px 5px 10px #b9bfca,inset -5px -5px 10px #fff}
.neu-tgl input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;cursor:pointer}
.neu-tgl .knob{position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:#e0e5ec;
  box-shadow:3px 3px 6px #b9bfca,-3px -3px 6px #fff;transition:.26s}
.neu-tgl input:checked ~ .knob{left:32px;background:#7c9cff}
.neu-range{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;max-width:300px;height:14px;border-radius:100px;background:#e0e5ec;
  box-shadow:inset 4px 4px 8px #b9bfca,inset -4px -4px 8px #fff;outline:none;margin-top:6px}
.neu-range::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#e0e5ec;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:4px 4px 8px #b9bfca,-4px -4px 8px #fff}
.neu-range::-moz-range-thumb{width:26px;height:26px;border:none;border-radius:50%;background:#e0e5ec;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:4px 4px 8px #b9bfca,-4px -4px 8px #fff}

/* ============================================================
   3. CLAYMORPHISM
   ============================================================ */
.demo--clay{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c9d6ff,#e6b3ff)}
.clay-card{
  background:#fef1ff;border-radius:34px;padding:28px;max-width:340px;color:#6b3fa0;
  box-shadow:14px 14px 30px rgba(150,90,200,.35),inset 6px 6px 14px rgba(255,255,255,.9),inset -8px -8px 18px rgba(180,120,220,.35);
}
.clay-card h3{color:#7a2fd0}
.clay-card p{color:#9366bd;font-size:14px}
.clay-btn{
  margin-top:10px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;color:#fff;padding:15px 26px;border-radius:22px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff8fd0,#c86bff);transition:.2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  box-shadow:8px 8px 18px rgba(160,80,220,.4),inset 4px 4px 10px rgba(255,255,255,.55),inset -6px -6px 12px rgba(150,40,200,.35);
}
.clay-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.03)}
.clay-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px) scale(.98)}
.clay-emoji{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:30px;
  background:#c1f0d4;box-shadow:inset 4px 4px 10px rgba(255,255,255,.8),inset -6px -6px 12px rgba(90,190,140,.5),8px 8px 18px rgba(120,200,160,.4)}

/* ============================================================
   4. SKEUOMORPHISM
   ============================================================ */
.demo--skeu{
  background:
    linear-gradient(#4a4038,#3a322c);
  color:#f4e9d8;
}
.skeu-panel{
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(0,0,0,.05) 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px),
    linear-gradient(#6b5d4f,#5a4d40);
  border:1px solid #2f2822;border-radius:16px;padding:26px;max-width:380px;
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}
.skeu-panel h3{color:#fff5e6;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.skeu-panel p{color:#e5d4ba;font-size:14px}
.skeu-btn{
  margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:#3a2c14;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid #a67c2e;
  background:linear-gradient(#ffe08a,#f2b53d 48%,#d98f1e 52%,#c47a12);
  box-shadow:0 4px 0 #8a5a10,0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4),inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);transition:.08s
}
.skeu-btn:active{transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:0 0 0 #8a5a10,0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4),inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
/* realistic sliding switch */
.skeu-switch{width:88px;height:40px;border-radius:100px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;flex:none;
  background:linear-gradient(#2a221c,#3d332b);border:1px solid #1c1712;
  box-shadow:inset 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.skeu-switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;cursor:pointer}
.skeu-switch .knob{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;transition:.24s;
  background:linear-gradient(#fff,#c7c7c7);box-shadow:0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6),inset 0 1px 1px #fff}
.skeu-switch .txt{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em}
.skeu-switch .on{left:12px;color:#7dffa0;opacity:0;transition:.24s}
.skeu-switch .off{right:12px;color:#ff8a8a}
.skeu-switch input:checked ~ .knob{left:51px}
.skeu-switch input:checked ~ .on{opacity:1}
.skeu-switch input:checked ~ .off{opacity:0}

/* ============================================================
   5. FLAT DESIGN
   ============================================================ */
.demo--flat{background:#1abc9c;color:#fff}
.flat-card{background:#fff;color:#34495e;border-radius:6px;padding:26px;max-width:360px}
.flat-card h3{color:#2c3e50}
.flat-card p{color:#7f8c8d;font-size:14px}
.flat-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;margin:16px 0;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.flat-tabs button{flex:1;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:11px;font-weight:600;background:#ecf0f1;color:#7f8c8d;transition:.15s}
.flat-tabs button.active{background:#1abc9c;color:#fff}
.flat-btn{border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:#fff;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:5px;transition:.15s}
.flat-btn.c1{background:#e74c3c}.flat-btn.c1:hover{background:#c0392b}
.flat-btn.c2{background:#3498db}.flat-btn.c2:hover{background:#2980b9}
.flat-btn.c3{background:#9b59b6}.flat-btn.c3:hover{background:#8e44ad}

/* ============================================================
   6. MATERIAL DESIGN
   ============================================================ */
.demo--material{background:#f5f5f5;color:#212121}
.mat-card{background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:24px;max-width:360px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
.mat-card h3{color:#212121;font-weight:600}
.mat-card p{color:#757575;font-size:14px}
.mat-field{position:relative;margin:22px 0 8px}
.mat-field input{width:100%;border:none;border-bottom:2px solid #bdbdbd;background:#fafafa;padding:16px 12px 8px;font-size:15px;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;outline:none;transition:.2s}
.mat-field input:focus{border-color:#6200ee}
.mat-field label{position:absolute;left:12px;top:15px;color:#9e9e9e;pointer-events:none;transition:.16s}
.mat-field input:focus + label,.mat-field input:not(:placeholder-shown) + label{top:2px;font-size:11px;color:#6200ee}
.mat-btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;
  text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;color:#fff;background:#6200ee;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:6px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(98,0,238,.4);transition:.18s}
.mat-btn:hover{box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(98,0,238,.5)}
.mat-fab{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;font-size:26px;padding:0;background:#03dac6;color:#00201c;
  box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.ripple{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;transform:scale(0);animation:ripple .6s linear;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);pointer-events:none}
@keyframes ripple{to{transform:scale(2.6);opacity:0}}

/* ============================================================
   7. NEO-BRUTALISM
   ============================================================ */
.demo--brutal{background:#ffde59;color:#111}
.demo--brutal *{font-family:'Space Grotesk',var(--font-ui)}
.brutal-card{background:#fff;border:3px solid #111;border-radius:2px;padding:24px;max-width:360px;
  box-shadow:8px 8px 0 #111}
.brutal-card h3{font-weight:800;font-size:22px}
.brutal-card p{font-weight:500;font-size:14px}
.brutal-btn{border:3px solid #111;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:2px;
  box-shadow:5px 5px 0 #111;transition:.1s;color:#111}
.brutal-btn.p1{background:#ff5c8a}.brutal-btn.p2{background:#4ad991}.brutal-btn.p3{background:#5b9dff;color:#fff}
.brutal-btn:hover{transform:translate(-2px,-2px);box-shadow:7px 7px 0 #111}
.brutal-btn:active{transform:translate(3px,3px);box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #111}
.brutal-input{border:3px solid #111;background:#fff;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:600;border-radius:2px;width:100%;max-width:280px;
  box-shadow:5px 5px 0 #111;outline:none}
.brutal-tag{display:inline-block;background:#111;color:#ffde59;font-weight:800;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:2px;font-size:12px;transform:rotate(-2deg)}

/* ============================================================
   8. MINIMALISM
   ============================================================ */
.demo--min{background:#fbfbf9;color:#1a1a1a}
.min-wrap{max-width:520px}
.min-wrap .kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#999}
.min-wrap h3{font-weight:400;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:12px 0 14px;line-height:1.15}
.min-wrap p{color:#666;font-size:15px;max-width:44ch}
.min-rule{height:1px;background:#e5e5e0;margin:26px 0}
.min-btn{background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid #1a1a1a;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 0;font-size:15px;
  color:#1a1a1a;transition:.25s;letter-spacing:.02em}
.min-btn:hover{letter-spacing:.14em}
.min-btn .arw{transition:.25s;display:inline-block}
.min-btn:hover .arw{transform:translateX(6px)}

/* ============================================================
   9. DARK MODE
   ============================================================ */
.demo--dark{background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3}
.dark-card{background:#161b22;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:14px;padding:26px;max-width:360px}
.dark-card h3{color:#f0f6fc}
.dark-card p{color:#8b949e;font-size:14px}
.dark-btn{border:1px solid #2ea04340;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:#3fb950;background:#12261a;
  padding:11px 20px;border-radius:8px;transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(63,185,80,0)}
.dark-btn:hover{background:#173a24;box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(63,185,80,.35)}
.dark-tgl .track{background:#30363d}
.dark-tgl input:checked ~ .track{background:#2ea043}
.dark-tgl .knob{background:#e6edf3}
.dark-chip{display:inline-flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:#8b949e;margin-top:14px}
.dark-chip .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#3fb950;box-shadow:0 0 10px #3fb950}

/* ============================================================
   10. AURORA / MESH GRADIENT
   ============================================================ */
.demo--aurora{background:#05010f;color:#fff}
.aurora-bg{position:absolute;inset:-30%;filter:blur(70px);opacity:.9;z-index:0}
.aurora-bg span{position:absolute;width:46%;height:46%;border-radius:50%;mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:auroraMove 12s ease-in-out infinite}
.aurora-bg span:nth-child(1){background:#7c3aff;top:5%;left:8%}
.aurora-bg span:nth-child(2){background:#ff3d9a;top:30%;left:55%;animation-delay:-3s}
.aurora-bg span:nth-child(3){background:#12d8fa;top:50%;left:20%;animation-delay:-6s}
.aurora-bg span:nth-child(4){background:#ffd166;top:12%;left:65%;animation-delay:-9s}
@keyframes auroraMove{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}33%{transform:translate(28%,18%) scale(1.25)}66%{transform:translate(-22%,10%) scale(.85)}}
.aurora-card{position:relative;z-index:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;max-width:360px}
.aurora-card h3{font-weight:700}
.aurora-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:14px}
.aurora-btn{margin-top:14px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:#0b0320;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:100px;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#12d8fa,#a855f7,#ff3d9a);background-size:200% auto;transition:.4s;
  box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(168,85,247,.5)}
.aurora-btn:hover{background-position:right center;transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ============================================================
   11. VAPORWAVE / SYNTHWAVE
   ============================================================ */
.demo--vapor{background:linear-gradient(#2a0845,#6441a5 55%,#ff6ec7);color:#fff;font-family:'Space Grotesk',var(--font-ui)}
.vapor-sun{position:absolute;top:26px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(#fff3a0,#ff6ec7 55%,#7a2fd0);z-index:0;box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(255,110,199,.7)}
.vapor-sun::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(#000 0 6px,transparent 6px 12px);mask:linear-gradient(transparent 46%,#000 46%);
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(transparent 46%,#000 46%)}
.vapor-grid{position:absolute;left:-10%;right:-10%;bottom:0;height:46%;z-index:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255,110,199,.6) 2px,transparent 2px) 0 0/100% 26px,
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,110,199,.6) 2px,transparent 2px) 0 0/48px 100%;
  transform:perspective(280px) rotateX(62deg);transform-origin:bottom}
.vapor-card{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-top:120px;text-align:center;max-width:420px;margin-inline:auto}
.vapor-card h3{font-size:clamp(30px,7vw,52px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;margin:0;
  color:#fff;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 #ff2d95,-3px -3px 0 #12d8fa}
.vapor-jp{font-family:'Space Grotesk';letter-spacing:.4em;color:#12f5ff;font-size:13px;text-shadow:0 0 10px #12f5ff}
.vapor-btn{margin-top:20px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;
  border:2px solid #12f5ff;background:rgba(18,245,255,.12);padding:12px 26px;border-radius:4px;
  box-shadow:0 0 18px #12f5ff,inset 0 0 12px rgba(18,245,255,.4);text-shadow:0 0 8px #12f5ff;transition:.2s}
.vapor-btn:hover{background:rgba(18,245,255,.28);box-shadow:0 0 34px #12f5ff,inset 0 0 20px rgba(18,245,255,.6)}

/* ============================================================
   12. CYBERPUNK / HUD
   ============================================================ */
.demo--cyber{background:#08010d;color:#e6f9ff;font-family:'Space Grotesk',var(--font-ui)}
.cyber-panel{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,0,110,.08),rgba(0,255,247,.08));
  border:1px solid #00fff7;padding:26px;max-width:400px;color:#c9fff9;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 22px) 0,100% 22px,100% 100%,22px 100%,0 calc(100% - 22px));
  box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(0,255,247,.25),inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,247,.08)}
.cyber-panel h3{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 12px #ff006e}
.cyber-tag{font-family:'VT323',monospace;font-size:16px;color:#ffed4a;letter-spacing:.12em}
.cyber-panel p{color:#8fd9d4;font-size:14px}
.cyber-bar{height:8px;background:#0e2a2a;border:1px solid #00fff7;margin-top:16px;overflow:hidden}
.cyber-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:72%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00fff7,#ff006e);box-shadow:0 0 12px #00fff7}
.cyber-btn{margin-top:18px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px;
  color:#08010d;background:#00fff7;border:none;padding:12px 22px;transition:.15s;
  clip-path:polygon(8px 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 8px) 100%,0 100%);box-shadow:0 0 18px #00fff7}
.cyber-btn:hover{background:#ff006e;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 26px #ff006e}
.glitch{position:relative}
.glitch:hover::before,.glitch:hover::after{content:attr(data-text);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;overflow:hidden}
.glitch:hover::before{color:#ff006e;transform:translate(-2px,-1px);clip-path:inset(0 0 55% 0)}
.glitch:hover::after{color:#00fff7;transform:translate(2px,1px);clip-path:inset(55% 0 0 0)}

/* ============================================================
   13. BENTO GRID
   ============================================================ */
.demo--bento{background:#0f1115;color:#eef1f7}
.bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-auto-rows:104px;gap:14px;max-width:600px}
.bento .cell{border-radius:18px;padding:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;transition:.25s}
.bento .cell:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.bento .cell b{font-size:15px}
.bento .cell small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:12px}
.bento .c-a{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aff,#4260ff)}
.bento .c-b{grid-column:span 2;background:#191c22}
.bento .c-c{background:#191c22}
.bento .c-d{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff6ec7,#ff8f5c)}
.bento .c-e{grid-column:span 2;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12d8fa,#2ea043)}
.bento .c-f{background:#191c22}
.bento .big-num{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;line-height:1}

/* ============================================================
   14. MEMPHIS
   ============================================================ */
.demo--memphis{background:#fef6e4;color:#232323}
.demo--memphis .shape{position:absolute;z-index:0}
.m-s1{width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff5470;top:24px;left:24px}
.m-s2{width:0;height:0;border-left:34px solid transparent;border-right:34px solid transparent;border-bottom:60px solid #ffd803;top:40px;right:60px;transform:rotate(18deg)}
.m-s3{width:70px;height:70px;background:#00c2a8;bottom:30px;left:80px;transform:rotate(20deg)}
.m-s4{width:120px;height:40px;border:6px solid #6246ea;border-radius:0 0 120px 120px;border-top:0;bottom:40px;right:40px}
.m-dots{position:absolute;top:30%;left:44%;width:70px;height:70px;z-index:0;
  background:radial-gradient(#232323 3px,transparent 3px) 0 0/16px 16px}
.memphis-card{position:relative;z-index:1;background:#fff;border:3px solid #232323;border-radius:14px;padding:26px;max-width:360px;
  box-shadow:9px 9px 0 #6246ea}
.memphis-card h3{font-weight:800;font-size:24px}
.memphis-card p{font-size:14px;color:#555}
.memphis-btn{margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;color:#232323;border:3px solid #232323;background:#ffd803;
  padding:12px 22px;border-radius:100px;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #232323;transition:.12s}
.memphis-btn:hover{transform:rotate(-2deg) translateY(-2px)}
.memphis-btn:active{transform:translate(3px,3px);box-shadow:1px 1px 0 #232323}

/* ============================================================
   15. SWISS / INTERNATIONAL TYPOGRAPHIC
   ============================================================ */
.demo--swiss{background:#f4f4f2;color:#111}
.swiss{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:16px;font-family:'Archivo Black','Space Grotesk',var(--font-ui)}
.swiss .big{grid-column:1/9;font-size:clamp(40px,9vw,96px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0;text-transform:uppercase}
.swiss .big em{color:#e30613;font-style:normal}
.swiss .num{grid-column:9/13;font-size:clamp(40px,9vw,96px);color:#e30613;text-align:right;line-height:.9;margin:0}
.swiss .meta{grid-column:1/5;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em;border-top:3px solid #111;padding-top:10px}
.swiss .body{grid-column:5/9;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-weight:400;font-size:14px;color:#333;border-top:3px solid #111;padding-top:10px}
.swiss .link{grid-column:9/13;font-family:var(--font-ui);border-top:3px solid #e30613;padding-top:10px;text-align:right}
.swiss .link a{color:#111;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:2px solid #111}
.swiss .link a:hover{color:#e30613;border-color:#e30613}

/* ============================================================
   16. Y2K / FRUTIGER AERO
   ============================================================ */
.demo--y2k{background:linear-gradient(#bfe9ff,#e9f7ff 60%,#d6f5e0);color:#0a3d62}
.y2k-card{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(#ffffff,#dff1ff);border:1px solid #8fd3ff;border-radius:22px;padding:26px;max-width:360px;
  box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(60,140,220,.35),inset 0 2px 4px #fff}
.y2k-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;top:8px;height:38%;border-radius:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.85),rgba(255,255,255,0));pointer-events:none}
.y2k-card h3{position:relative;font-weight:800;color:#0a6fd6;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff}
.y2k-card p{position:relative;color:#3a7bad;font-size:14px}
.y2k-btn{position:relative;margin-top:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;color:#fff;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid #1173c9;
  background:linear-gradient(#7cccff,#1e8fe0 50%,#0a6fd6);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8),0 6px 14px rgba(20,110,200,.4);
  text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,40,90,.5);overflow:hidden;transition:.15s}
.y2k-btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;top:3px;height:42%;border-radius:100px;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.9),rgba(255,255,255,0))}
.y2k-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.y2k-orb{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;position:relative;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%,#fff,#6ad0ff 40%,#0a6fd6);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(20,110,200,.4)}
.y2k-orb::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:22%;top:14%;width:34%;height:24%;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);filter:blur(1px)}

/* ============================================================
   17. RETRO TERMINAL / CRT
   ============================================================ */
.demo--crt{background:#020a02;color:#33ff66;font-family:'VT323',ui-monospace,monospace}
.crt-screen{position:relative;background:#020a02;border-radius:14px;padding:26px;max-width:520px;
  border:1px solid #0f3d17;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(51,255,102,.25),inset 0 0 60px rgba(51,255,102,.12)}
.crt-screen::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:14px;pointer-events:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0) 0 2px,rgba(0,0,0,.28) 2px 4px)}
.crt-screen *{text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(51,255,102,.7)}
.crt-line{font-size:20px;line-height:1.5}
.crt-line .p{color:#1fbf4d}
.crt-out{min-height:2.6em;font-size:20px;line-height:1.4}
.crt-cursor{display:inline-block;width:11px;height:20px;background:#33ff66;vertical-align:-3px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite;box-shadow:0 0 8px #33ff66}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.crt-btn{margin-top:16px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'VT323',monospace;font-size:19px;color:#020a02;background:#33ff66;
  border:none;padding:6px 18px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.06em;transition:.12s}
.crt-btn:hover{box-shadow:0 0 18px #33ff66}

/* ============================================================
   18. METRO / FLUENT
   ============================================================ */
.demo--metro{background:#1d1d1d;color:#fff;font-family:'Space Grotesk',var(--font-ui)}
.metro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;max-width:440px}
.metro .tile{padding:14px;min-height:104px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;position:relative}
.metro .tile:hover{transform:scale(.97)}
.metro .tile .ic{font-size:26px}
.metro .tile b{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.metro .t1{background:#0078d7}.metro .t2{background:#e3008c}.metro .t3{background:#00b294}
.metro .t4{background:#ff8c00}.metro .t5{background:#68217a}.metro .t6{background:#e81123}
.metro .wide{grid-column:span 2}
.metro .tall{grid-row:span 2;min-height:auto}
.metro .acrylic{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)}

/* ============================================================
   19. BRUTALISM (RAW WEB)
   ============================================================ */
.demo--rawbrut{background:#fff;color:#111;font-family:'Times New Roman',Times,serif}
.raw-wrap{max-width:560px}
.raw-marquee{background:#000;color:#33ff66;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:13px;padding:5px 0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:16px;border:2px solid #000}
.raw-marquee span{display:inline-block;padding-left:100%;animation:rawScroll 13s linear infinite}
@keyframes rawScroll{to{transform:translateX(-100%)}}
.raw-wrap h3{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 8px;text-decoration:underline}
.raw-wrap p{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.5}
.raw-wrap a{color:#0000ee;text-decoration:underline}
.raw-wrap a:hover{color:#ee0000}
.raw-box{border:2px solid #000;padding:14px;margin:14px 0;max-width:440px}
.raw-box hr{border:none;border-top:2px solid #000;margin:10px 0}
.raw-input{border:2px solid #000;padding:7px 8px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:14px;width:55%}
.raw-btn{border:2px solid #000;background:#c0c0c0;padding:6px 14px;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
.raw-btn:hover{background:#e4e4e4}
.raw-btn:active{background:#000;color:#fff}

/* ============================================================
   20. HOLOGRAPHIC / IRIDESCENT
   ============================================================ */
.demo--holo{background:#08080f;color:#fff}
.holo-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;padding:28px;max-width:360px;color:#141422;
  background:linear-gradient(115deg,#ff9ce3,#a5e8ff 20%,#c3ffd6 40%,#fff6a8 55%,#c9a3ff 75%,#ff9ce3 95%);
  background-size:300% 300%;animation:holoShift 7s ease infinite;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(150,120,255,.35)}
.holo-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:overlay;
  background:linear-gradient(60deg,transparent 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.65) 50%,transparent 60%);
  background-size:250% 250%;animation:holoSheen 7s ease infinite}
@keyframes holoShift{0%,100%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}}
@keyframes holoSheen{0%,100%{background-position:0% 0%}50%{background-position:100% 100%}}
.holo-card h3{position:relative;color:#191926;font-weight:800}
.holo-card p{position:relative;color:#2c2c40;font-size:14px}
.holo-btn{position:relative;margin-top:14px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;color:#fff;padding:12px 24px;border:none;border-radius:100px;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#a855f7,#ec4899,#06b6d4,#a855f7);background-size:300% auto;transition:.5s;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(168,85,247,.5)}
.holo-btn:hover{background-position:right center;transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ============================================================
   21. PIXEL / 8-BIT ARCADE
   ============================================================ */
.demo--pixel{background:#12122a;color:#fff;font-family:'Press Start 2P','VT323',monospace}
.pixel-card{background:#0f3460;border:4px solid #e94560;padding:22px;max-width:400px;
  box-shadow:8px 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4);image-rendering:pixelated}
.pixel-card h3{font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 12px;color:#ffe66d;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000}
.pixel-card p{font-size:10px;line-height:1.9;color:#a0d8ff}
.pixel-hp{display:flex;gap:5px;margin:14px 0}
.pixel-hp i{width:14px;height:14px;background:#e94560;box-shadow:inset -2px -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.pixel-hp i.off{background:#2a2a4a;box-shadow:none}
.pixel-start{font-size:11px;color:#4ad991;margin:12px 0;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #000}
.pixel-btn{margin-top:4px;font-family:'Press Start 2P','VT323',monospace;font-size:11px;color:#fff;background:#e94560;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #a32741,inset -3px -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:.05s}
.pixel-btn:active{transform:translateY(5px);box-shadow:0 0 0 #a32741,inset -3px -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}

/* ============================================================
   22. HAND-DRAWN / SKETCH
   ============================================================ */
.demo--sketch{background:#fffdf3;color:#2b2b2b}
.sketch-card{background:#fff;border:2.5px solid #2b2b2b;padding:26px;max-width:360px;
  border-radius:255px 15px 225px 15px/15px 225px 15px 255px;box-shadow:6px 7px 0 rgba(43,43,43,.12)}
.sketch-card h3{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 6px;font-weight:700}
.sketch-underline{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd43b,#ffd43b) 0 86%/100% 34% no-repeat;padding:0 2px}
.sketch-card p{font-size:14px;color:#555;margin:8px 0 0}
.sketch-btn{margin-top:16px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;background:#ffd43b;color:#2b2b2b;
  border:2.5px solid #2b2b2b;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:225px 15px 225px 15px/15px 225px 15px 225px;transition:.15s}
.sketch-btn:hover{transform:rotate(-1.5deg) translateY(-2px);box-shadow:4px 5px 0 rgba(43,43,43,.2)}
.sketch-check{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;position:relative}
.sketch-check input{position:absolute;opacity:0}
.sketch-check .bx{width:26px;height:26px;flex:none;border:2.5px solid #2b2b2b;border-radius:60% 40% 55% 45%/45% 55% 45% 55%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:16px}
.sketch-check .bx::after{content:"✓";opacity:0;transition:.15s;transform:rotate(-8deg);color:#2b2b2b}
.sketch-check input:checked ~ .bx::after{opacity:1}

/* ============================================================
   23. ISOMETRIC / 3D
   ============================================================ */
.demo--iso{background:#eaecf7;color:#26263a}
.iso-stage{perspective:1200px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:30px 0 20px}
.iso-card{width:260px;border-radius:16px;padding:24px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c5cff,#5b8cff);
  transform:rotateX(52deg) rotateZ(-42deg);transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:.55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  box-shadow:1px 1px 0 #4a3fb0,2px 2px 0 #4a3fb0,3px 3px 0 #4a3fb0,4px 4px 0 #4a3fb0,6px 6px 0 #443a9e,10px 10px 0 #3d3490,26px 32px 42px rgba(60,40,140,.4)}
.iso-card h3{margin:0 0 6px}
.iso-card p{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.88)}
.iso-card:hover{transform:rotateX(0deg) rotateZ(0deg);box-shadow:0 26px 52px rgba(60,40,140,.4)}
.iso-hint{text-align:center;color:#6a6a86;font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}

/* ============================================================
   24. ART DECO
   ============================================================ */
.demo--deco{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,#123a33,#0a1f1c);color:#e8d9a8}
.deco-card{position:relative;border:2px solid #c8a86b;padding:34px 30px;max-width:380px;text-align:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.deco-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:7px;border:1px solid #c8a86b;pointer-events:none}
.deco-fan{width:64px;height:32px;margin:0 auto 12px;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 180deg at 50% 100%,#c8a86b 0 8deg,transparent 8deg 16deg)}
.deco-sub{position:relative;letter-spacing:.4em;font-size:11px;color:#c8a86b;text-transform:uppercase}
.deco-card h3{position:relative;font-family:'Anton','Space Grotesk',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.26em;font-size:26px;margin:8px 0;color:#f0e2b6;text-transform:uppercase}
.deco-card p{position:relative;font-size:13px;color:#c9bd93;line-height:1.6;margin:14px 0}
.deco-btn{position:relative;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-ui);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
  color:#0a1f1c;background:linear-gradient(#e8cf94,#c8a86b);border:none;padding:12px 26px;transition:.2s}
.deco-btn:hover{background:linear-gradient(#f4e2ad,#d8b877);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(200,168,107,.5)}

/* ============================================================
   25. EDITORIAL / NEWSPAPER
   ============================================================ */
.demo--news{background:#f3efe4;color:#1a1a1a;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
.news{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
.news .head{text-align:center;border-bottom:4px double #1a1a1a;padding-bottom:8px}
.news .head .name{font-family:'Anton','Space Grotesk',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,7vw,52px);letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1}
.news .head .sub{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;border-top:1px solid #1a1a1a;margin-top:8px;padding-top:6px}
.news h3{font-family:'Anton','Space Grotesk',serif;font-size:26px;line-height:1.1;margin:16px 0 4px;text-transform:uppercase}
.news .byline{font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:#555;margin-bottom:12px}
.news .cols{column-count:2;column-gap:26px;column-rule:1px solid #cfc7b2;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.news .cols p{margin:0 0 10px}
.news .cols p:first-child::first-letter{float:left;font-size:3.4em;line-height:.72;padding:4px 8px 0 0;font-weight:700}

/* ============================================================
   26. LIQUID / ORGANIC BLOB
   ============================================================ */
.demo--liquid{background:#080b1a;color:#fff}
.liquid-blob{position:absolute;width:360px;height:360px;top:50%;left:18%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:0;filter:blur(2px);opacity:.9;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6d28d9,#db2777 55%,#f59e0b);border-radius:60% 40% 30% 70%/60% 30% 70% 40%;animation:blobMorph 9s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes blobMorph{0%,100%{border-radius:60% 40% 30% 70%/60% 30% 70% 40%;transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(0deg)}
  50%{border-radius:30% 60% 70% 40%/50% 60% 30% 60%;transform:translateY(-52%) rotate(18deg)}}
.liquid-card{position:relative;z-index:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-radius:26px;padding:28px;max-width:340px}
.liquid-card h3{font-weight:700}
.liquid-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:14px}
.liquid-btn{margin-top:14px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:#fff;padding:13px 26px;border:none;transition:.5s;
  border-radius:40% 60% 55% 45%/55% 45% 55% 45%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#db2777,#6d28d9);box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(219,39,119,.5)}
.liquid-btn:hover{border-radius:55% 45% 40% 60%/45% 55% 45% 55%;transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ============================================================
   27. MAXIMALISM
   ============================================================ */
.demo--maxi{color:#fff;background:
  repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,0,128,.22) 0 14px,transparent 14px 28px),
  repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,rgba(0,224,255,.18) 0 14px,transparent 14px 28px),
  radial-gradient(circle at 18% 28%,#ffde00 0 38px,transparent 39px),
  radial-gradient(circle at 86% 72%,#00e0b0 0 28px,transparent 29px),
  linear-gradient(135deg,#3a0ca3,#f72585 50%,#ff8500)}
.maxi-card{position:relative;background:#fff;color:#1a1a1a;border:4px solid #000;border-radius:20px;padding:28px 26px;max-width:390px;
  box-shadow:10px 10px 0 #00e0b0,-6px -6px 0 #f72585;transform:rotate(-1.5deg)}
.maxi-card h3{font-family:'Anton','Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:32px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 6px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f72585,#7209b7,#3a86ff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.maxi-card p{font-size:14px;color:#333}
.maxi-sticker{position:absolute;font-family:'Press Start 2P','VT323',monospace;font-size:10px;background:#ffde00;color:#000;
  padding:6px 8px;border:2px solid #000;border-radius:6px;transform:rotate(8deg);top:-14px;right:-10px}
.maxi-sticker.two{top:auto;bottom:-16px;left:-12px;right:auto;background:#00e0b0;transform:rotate(-10deg)}
.maxi-btn{margin-top:12px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;
  color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f72585,#ff8500);border:3px solid #000;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:100px;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #000;transition:.12s}
.maxi-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05) rotate(1deg)}
.maxi-btn:active{transform:translate(3px,3px);box-shadow:1px 1px 0 #000}

/* ============================================================
   28. CORPORATE MEMPHIS (ALEGRIA)
   ============================================================ */
.demo--corp{background:#f5f1ff;color:#33324d}
.corp-wrap{display:flex;gap:28px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.corp-art{position:relative;width:200px;height:190px;flex:none}
.corp-art .circle{position:absolute;width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffd6a5;top:24px;left:24px;z-index:0}
.corp-art .head{position:absolute;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:#f2a488;top:34px;left:84px;z-index:2}
.corp-art .body{position:absolute;width:92px;height:112px;background:#6c5ce7;border-radius:60px 60px 22px 22px;top:74px;left:60px;z-index:1}
.corp-art .arm{position:absolute;width:26px;height:82px;background:#f2a488;border-radius:20px;top:84px;left:44px;transform:rotate(18deg);z-index:2}
.corp-art .tri{position:absolute;width:0;height:0;border-left:22px solid transparent;border-right:22px solid transparent;border-bottom:38px solid #00b894;bottom:6px;right:16px;z-index:2}
.corp-art .plus{position:absolute;top:10px;right:12px;color:#e17055;font-size:28px;font-weight:800;z-index:2}
.corp-text{flex:1;min-width:220px}
.corp-text h3{font-weight:800;font-size:24px;margin:0 0 8px;color:#2d2b45}
.corp-text p{font-size:14px;color:#6b6a86}
.corp-btn{margin-top:14px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:#6c5ce7;border:none;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:12px;transition:.2s}
.corp-btn:hover{background:#5a4bd4;transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ============================================================
   29. WIREFRAME / LO-FI
   ============================================================ */
.demo--wire{background:#fafafa;color:#666;font-family:ui-monospace,'Courier New',monospace}
.wire-card{background:#fff;border:2px solid #b8b8b8;border-radius:8px;padding:22px;max-width:380px}
.wire-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;color:#999;border:1px dashed #b8b8b8;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:14px}
.wire-imgph{aspect-ratio:16/9;border:2px dashed #b8b8b8;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:16px;background:
  linear-gradient(to top right,transparent calc(50% - 1px),#d3d3d3 50%,transparent calc(50% + 1px)),
  linear-gradient(to bottom right,transparent calc(50% - 1px),#d3d3d3 50%,transparent calc(50% + 1px)),#f0f0f0}
.wire-line{height:12px;background:#e2e2e2;border-radius:4px;margin:9px 0}
.wire-line.title{height:20px;width:55%;background:#cfcfcf;margin-bottom:16px}
.wire-line.w90{width:90%}.wire-line.w70{width:70%}.wire-line.w50{width:50%}
.wire-btn{margin-top:16px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;color:#555;background:#e2e2e2;border:2px solid #b8b8b8;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 20px;transition:.15s}
.wire-btn:hover{background:#d5d5d5}

/* ============================================================
   30. DUOTONE / GRADIENT
   ============================================================ */
.demo--duo{background:#0f0524;color:#fff}
.duo-card{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;max-width:360px;background:#1a0b33;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.duo-img{height:150px;position:relative;background:
  linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,0,153,.85),rgba(0,224,255,.85)),
  repeating-linear-gradient(60deg,rgba(255,255,255,.12) 0 10px,transparent 10px 22px)}
.duo-img::after{content:"DUOTONE";position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:13px;color:#fff;mix-blend-mode:overlay}
.duo-body{padding:22px}
.duo-body h3{margin:0 0 6px}
.duo-body p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:14px}
.duo-btn{margin-top:14px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:#0f0524;padding:12px 24px;border:none;border-radius:10px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff0099,#00e0ff);background-size:200% auto;transition:.5s;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(255,0,153,.4)}
.duo-btn:hover{background-position:right center;transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ============================================================
   Responsive
   ============================================================ */
@media(max-width:640px){
  .news .cols{column-count:1}
  .corp-wrap{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  .bento{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .bento .c-a,.bento .c-b,.bento .c-e{grid-column:span 2}
  .swiss{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
  .swiss .big{grid-column:1/7}.swiss .num{grid-column:1/7;text-align:left}
  .swiss .meta{grid-column:1/4}.swiss .body{grid-column:4/7}.swiss .link{grid-column:1/7;text-align:left}
  .metro{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .nav-brand small{display:none}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
}
/* ============================================================
   31. LIQUID GLASS (visionOS / spatial)
   ============================================================ */
.demo--lgls{
  background:
    radial-gradient(800px 420px at 20% 20%,#ffb15c,transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(700px 400px at 80% 30%,#4f7bff,transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 500px at 50% 110%,#12d6a0,transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(160deg,#1b2340,#3d1f5e 60%,#0e1b33);
  color:#fff;
}
.lgls-panel{
  position:relative;max-width:400px;border-radius:30px;padding:24px;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,.07));
  backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(190%) brightness(1.08);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(190%) brightness(1.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.65),inset 0 -18px 30px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),box-shadow .5s;
}
.lgls-panel:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.015);box-shadow:0 40px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.lgls-panel::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:30px;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 50%,transparent 60%);
  opacity:.55;mix-blend-mode:overlay
}
.lgls-panel h3{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.lgls-panel p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:14px}
.lgls-seg{display:flex;gap:2px;margin:18px 0 14px;padding:3px;border-radius:100px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.lgls-seg label{flex:1;position:relative;text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  padding:8px 4px;border-radius:100px;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.lgls-seg input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;cursor:pointer}
.lgls-seg label:has(input:checked){background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);color:#1b2340;
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.lgls-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.lgls-range{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;flex:1;height:26px;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);outline:none}
.lgls-range::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;
  background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.lgls-range::-moz-range-thumb{width:22px;height:22px;border:none;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;
  background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.lgls-tgl .track{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.lgls-tgl input:checked ~ .track{background:rgba(80,220,160,.75)}

/* ============================================================
   32. AERO (Windows Vista / 7 glass)
   ============================================================ */
.demo--aero{background:linear-gradient(#3c7cbe,#1b3f6d 60%,#0f2745);color:#fff}
.aero-win{
  max-width:420px;border-radius:9px 9px 5px 5px;overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
.aero-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.9),0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6);color:#0b2440;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.62),rgba(255,255,255,.28) 48%,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 52%,rgba(255,255,255,.3));
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25)
}
.aero-dots{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:5px}
.aero-dots button{width:26px;height:17px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.85),rgba(180,210,240,.6));transition:.15s}
.aero-dots button:hover{background:linear-gradient(#fff,#bcd9f5);box-shadow:0 0 10px #aee0ff}
.aero-dots button.x{background:linear-gradient(#ff8a7a,#c9291b)}

# Token-Efficient Coding

This skill makes coding sessions cheaper in tokens by cutting **redundant actions**, never by cutting **quality**. If a rule below would make the code worse, less complete, less safe, or less explained, that rule does not apply — quality always wins over savings.

## The 7 rules

1. **Don't reprint full file contents in chat.** After using `create_file` or `str_replace`, do not paste the whole file's code again in the chat response. The file itself (or artifact) is already viewable by the user. Only show code in chat if the user explicitly asks to see it, or if showing a short snippet is the clearest way to explain one specific change.

2. **Edit, don't rewrite.** When changing an existing file, use `str_replace` on the specific lines that need to change. Do not regenerate the entire file with `create_file` unless the changes are so extensive that a full rewrite is genuinely clearer/safer than multiple edits.

3. **Read only what's needed.** For large files, use `view` with a `view_range` instead of loading the whole file. Don't re-`view` a file that is already visible in the current conversation and hasn't been changed since.

4. **Summarize changes, don't restate them.** After writing or editing code, describe what changed in a few sentences instead of re-explaining or re-printing the code line by line. Save detailed walkthroughs for when the user asks "explain this" or "why did you do X."

5. **Avoid duplication inside the generated code itself — but only once it actually pays off.** For a small number of similar items (roughly 3-5, e.g. a handful of UI cards), plain repeated blocks are often just as short and more readable than a loop/config structure, so don't force abstraction there. Once the count is larger (roughly 6+ similar items — game objects, API routes, list entries, repeated components) or the items are likely to grow/change together, switch to a loop, function, or config-driven structure. Always match the style the codebase already uses. When unsure which is shorter, default to whichever is more readable, not whichever is shorter.

6. **Batch independent file edits.** When a task touches multiple independent files, plan out all the needed changes before starting, then make them in as few round trips as possible, rather than editing one file, re-viewing, editing another, re-viewing, etc.

7. **Don't restate the request at length.** Move directly into doing the work instead of opening with a long paraphrase of what the user asked for. A one-line acknowledgment is fine if natural.

## What this skill must NEVER do

These are hard boundaries — violating any of them to save tokens is a failure of this skill, not a success:

- Never shorten variable/function names, remove comments, or remove docstrings to save tokens.
- Never drop error handling, input validation, edge cases, or tests that the task calls for.
- Never reduce explanation depth when the user explicitly asks for an explanation, walkthrough, or "why."
- Never skip steps in multi-step debugging (e.g., skipping reproduction, root-cause analysis, or verification) just to finish faster.
- Never sacrifice correctness, readability, or completeness for brevity. If in doubt, prioritize quality and accept the extra tokens.

## Quick self-check before responding

- Am I about to paste code I just wrote/edited back into the chat unprompted? → Don't, unless asked.
- Am I about to `create_file` over a file I could `str_replace` instead? → Use `str_replace`.
- Am I about to `view` a file I've already seen unchanged? → Skip it.
- Am I about to explain code in more detail than the user asked for? → Trim to a short summary.
- Would any of the above cuts make the actual code or its correctness worse? → If yes, don't cut it.
